name: io.github.ferry-vn/ferry-mcp
title: FerryVN
description: Search Vietnam ferry voyages, seat maps and bookings on FerryVN; booking writes are opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: FERRY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Partner API key from the FerryVN dashboard

environmentVariables.name: FERRY_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose create_customer, create_booking and request_cancellation
